calculation.description: Position of today's close within the 5-day high-low range (0=at range low, 1=at range high). High CLV (close near the top of the 5-day range) predicts negative forward 1-day return: range-top exhaustion / mean reversion. Note the factor carries a NEGATIVE IC, so the tradable signal is -CLV: low factor value -> overweight.
calculation.sign_convention: raw factor has negative IC; use -clv_5d as the long signal (close near 5d range low -> overweight)

validation.admission_gate: |IC|>=0.0070 and |ICIR|>=0.0840 (15-instrument cross-asset universe) - PASSED (on absolute value; sign is negative)
validation.regime_notes: Negative IC in all years 2021-2026; stronger in high-VIX regimes (IC=-0.072, ICIR=-0.226) than low-VIX (IC=-0.013, ICIR=-0.041); time drift mild (early IC=-0.058 vs late IC=-0.027). Predictive power concentrated at the 1-day horizon, decays to ~0 by 10 days and slightly reverses sign at 20-30 days. Pooled rank correlation with rev_1d = -0.638 (complementary reversal family).
